title: feat(components): the record's close button moves to the left of the top bar's navigation row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #36557
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：电脑上打开记录整页，或在列表上打开记录侧滑面板时，关闭按钮 ✕ 从右上角移到左上角，排在「↑ ↓ 第 N 条，共 M 条」前面；「以整页打开」按钮仍在右边，手机版不变。
- 为什么做：维护者要求把记录详情的关闭按钮改到左上角（记录详情页主题）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是 ✕ 显示的位置不对，关闭本身照常（✕、Esc、点视图名回列表都没改）；直接撤回这个 PR 即可恢复原位置。
- 要你做什么：看一眼截图里整页的 ✕ 排在侧边栏展开按钮左边是否合意。

## What changes

- `RecordTopBar` (`@object-ui/components`) takes a new optional prop, `close` (a ReactNode slot shaped like `leading` and `frame`), for the button that closes the record. The two-row bar draws it as the **first control of the navigation row**, before `leading`, ↑ ↓ and the "N of M · view" counter. The one-row bar (the phone face, and drawers whose host hands no record row) draws it **last at the right end, after `frame`**, which is where the close button sat before, so those faces do not change. The docblock describes the new placement.
- `NavigationOverlay` passes its close button as `close`. Only the expand button stays in `frame`. On the drawer, split pane and maximized pane, the close button is now at the top left and the expand button stays at the right.
- `RecordDetailView` (page face; only the `pageFrame` hunk): the page's close button (`record-page-close`) moves from `pageFrame` to `close`. `pageFrame` now holds only the shell's button group. Page order: the close button, then the host's `leading` (the sidebar expand control, then the breadcrumb).
- The close button keeps its accessible name ("Close") and its handler. Escape and the view-name link back to the list are unchanged. The close button now comes first in Tab order because DOM order is Tab order.
- No new metadata key, no new i18n string, no new export. The only widening is the one optional prop, hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. The changeset is `.changeset/36557-record-top-bar-close-left.md` (`@object-ui/components` patch). `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and needs no changeset.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx`: the two-row navigation row (the new `data-record-top-bar-close` wrapper drawn before the leading div) and the one-row controls (`{close}` after `{frame}`, plus the two divider conditions that now count `close`).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: `pageClose` / `pageFrame`. This hunk is disjoint from #36583's hunks in the same file.
3. `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`: `frame` keeps the expand button only; `close` takes the close button.

Two-minute check: open any record from a list in the console and look at the drawer. The close button is the leftmost control of the top row, and the expand button is the rightmost. Click "Open as full page": the page shows the close button leftmost too. Click it and you are back on the list.

## Tests

- `record-top-bar-two-rows-35853.test.tsx` (components) is rewritten. Two-row bar: the navigation row's buttons in DOM order start with Close and end with the frame's expand button. One-row CONTROL: the close button is the last element of the controls, right after `frame`, and there is no `data-record-top-bar-close` wrapper. Drawer (`NavigationOverlay`): the first nav button is Close, the last is "Open as full page", `frame` holds only the expand button, and clicking the close button calls the host's `close` handler once.
- `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524.test.tsx` (app-shell) is rewritten for the page face. The first button of the navigation row is `record-page-close`, its aria-label is "Close", and it is not inside `frame`. It still navigates to the object's list. With the shell group on, the group sits in `frame` without the close button. With the shell group off, `frame` is empty and the close button is still first.
- `record-top-bar-27524.test.tsx` is unchanged and stays green. It pins the one-row drawer's right-end order (… "Open as full page", "Close").

The verification readings are in the collapsed sections below.

## Acceptance notes

- Phone face: unchanged by construction. The phone page bar passes no `close` (its right end is the `⋯` slot), and every one-row bar draws `close` last at the right. No matching phone change is needed for this card.
- `overlap-check` reports this branch against draft PR #36583 because both touch `RecordDetailView.tsx`. The hunks are disjoint (#36583 never touches `pageFrame` / `record-page-close`). The area lands this PR after #36583 merges, and this branch merges `main` first.
- The Sheet primitive's own close button is still rendered and hidden by `NavigationOverlay`'s `[&>button:last-of-type]:hidden`, as before. The drawer test therefore clicks the bar's close button inside the navigation row instead of looking it up by role.

## Verification

<details><summary>Screenshots: the page and the drawer, before and after (CRM example, 1440 px wide)</summary>

I ran my own stack: the CRM example backend (`--fresh`, a random port) and the console's Vite dev server pointed at it, then drove it with Playwright on Chromium. "Before" swaps in main's three source files (`git restore --source=f4c2d0b1b9`) and "after" uses this branch's head. Afterwards the files were restored to HEAD (`git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob for all three, and `git diff HEAD` is empty). The servers were stopped by their own ports.

- Page, before: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36557-page-before.png`. Navigation-row buttons in DOM order: `["Comments","Edit app","Help & Documentation","Close"]`.
- Page, after: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36557-page-after.png`. Order: `["Close","Comments","Edit app","Help & Documentation"]`. The close button sits at the far left, before the "Accounts" breadcrumb. The shell group stays at the right.
- Drawer over the list, before: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36557-drawer-before.png`. Order: `["Previous record","Next record","All Records","Open as full page","Close"]`.
- Drawer over the list, after: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36557-drawer-after.png`. Order: `["Close","Previous record","Next record","All Records","Open as full page"]`. The close button is at the top left and the expand button stays at the top right.

The sidebar was expanded in these runs, so the page's sidebar-expand control was not drawn. When it is drawn, it follows the close button because it belongs to `leading`.
</details>

<details><summary>Tests: affected package tests and type-check at dc760d8732 (the implementation head, before the main merge)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/` plus every app-shell and console test file that mentions the bar or `record-page-close` (15 files): `Test Files 521 passed | 1 skipped (522)`, `Tests 5186 passed | 24 skipped (5210)`, `os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The merge of `main` (f4c2d0b1b9) brought no change to the bar, its hosts or their tests. `overlap-check` at 152e0ff9d2: `#36583 (shares ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx): merges cleanly`, `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: putting the close button back at the far right turns the new pins red</summary>

Mutation in `record-top-bar.tsx`, made with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and confirmed on disk by the tool's own counts and blob hashes:
1. the two-row `{close !== undefined && (` became `{false && (` (anchor count 1 then 0);
2. `{close}` was appended after `{frame}` in the two-row frame div (anchor count 1 then 0).

The test resolves the component from `src` through a relative import, so no `dist` was involved.

- With the mutation: `record-top-bar-two-rows-35853.test.tsx` gives `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`. The three failures are the two-row list case, the no-list case and the drawer case. The two that pass are the Chinese counter and the one-row CONTROL, as expected.
- Restore: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (b1efd8f95bfa) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 38 of 38 run at 152e0ff9d2, with the ledger and its reconciliation</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 152e0ff9d2 (the merge of main f4c2d0b1b9) derived 38 commands. I ran each with stdin from `/dev/null` and captured the exit code before any pipe. Ledger: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36557-gates-ran.txt`.
- 37 exited 0 on the first pass. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` first recorded exit 99: it never got the lock because the CRM build held it, so it was not measured. The re-run under the lock exited 0 (`Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, `Tests 5127 passed | 2 skipped (5129)`). The ledger keeps both lines.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `Run reconciliation — 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The tool flags the doubled vitest entry and reads it as 99 until the record holds a single line; the 0 above is the re-run.
- Outside the derived set: `overlap-check` `VERDICT clean exit 0` (#36583 merges cleanly); `pnpm check:new-line-citations` `0 new citation(s)`; `check-nul-bytes` exit 0. After the merge, the three top-bar pin files: `Tests 26 passed (26)`.
- CI on 152e0ff9d2: all eleven required contexts are success or skipped by their own selectors. Success: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (16/16 shards), `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`. Skipped: `Build Core`. `Check Changeset` is also success.
</details>
